title: Spice and rice: pepper, cloves and everyday cereal foods at the ancient port of Mantai, Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: E. Kingwell-Banham et al. / Antiquity / Cambridge University Press
scope: Mantai chronology, archaeobotany, imported ceramics and role as a gateway between the Anuradhapura interior and Indian Ocean exchange
limitations: Site- and excavation-specific evidence; the inferred ancient Malvatu Oya channel and river traffic remain reconstruction rather than direct continuous-route proof.

title: From ‘collapse’ to urban diaspora: the transformation of low-density, dispersed agrarian urbanism
author_or_institution: L. J. Lucero et al. / Antiquity / Cambridge University Press
scope: Anuradhapura low-density urbanism, dry-zone water storage, reservoirs, feeder canals and transformation after the eleventh century
limitations: Comparative urbanism paper; hydraulic development is summarized from broader Anuradhapura research and should not be read as a single centralized state-control model.

title: The state of theocracy: defining an early medieval hinterland in Sri Lanka
author_or_institution: Robin Coningham et al. / Antiquity / Cambridge University Press
scope: Archaeological survey of Anuradhapura hinterland and prominence of monastic sites in the urban-period landscape
limitations: Interpretive model of hinterland administration has been refined in later work; monasteries should not be treated as the sole political or economic authority.

title: Sri Lanka at the Crossroads of History
author_or_institution: Zoltán Biedermann and Alan Strathern (eds.) / UCL Press
scope: Archaeology, cosmopolitanism, monastic administration and Indian Ocean connectivity in Sri Lankan history
limitations: Edited scholarly synthesis; individual propositions should be tied to the cited archaeological chapters and datasets where possible.
